welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: Let's learn the basics of Eureka Flow. Click Next to get started.

sidebar.title: Block Library
sidebar.description: On the left is the Block Library. Browse input, process, and output blocks, then click to add them to your canvas.

canvas.title: Workflow Canvas
canvas.description: This is your workspace. Two blocks are already placed — connect them by dragging between ports. Scroll to zoom, drag empty space to pan.

connect.title: Connect the blocks
connect.description: Drag from the blue dot (●) on the right side of "My First Input" to the blue dot on the left side of "Result".

run.title: Run it!
run.description: Click the ▷ play button on "My First Input" to execute. The result will appear in the Preview block.

done.title: You did it! 🎉
done.description: Get a free API key to save your work and use AI blocks.
